4279-4976-5933--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4976-5933--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4693-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4693-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-6012-6797--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 5.

5147-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4770-6720.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1580-4871-4976-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-7371-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1636-7371-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Rite of the Dragoncaller triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2981-4907-6556-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with power 4 or greater.
2981-4907-6556-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

240-4927-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

57-4742-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4742-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7153.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3789-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-5913-5938.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Flare of Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
232-1235-5913-5938.notes: You can sacrifice a nontoken red creature not used in this combo instead of paying Flare of Duplication's mana cost.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-6924-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6924-7060.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-6006-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-4506.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

862-4053-5231-6989.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

104-3197-4321-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3197-4321-6890.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3180-5220-6247.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Chamber Sentry from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Chamber Sentry from your library.
Repeat.

2173-3967-5220-6535.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

3664-5701-5720-5721-6664.notablePrerequisites:
There are two mana-producing land cards in your graveyard.
There are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard excluding the "Creature" type.
3664-5701-5720-5721-6664.description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

1580-4050-6351.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

440-1339-4050-4268.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-4268.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1429-2099-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2099-4875-5402.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3680-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3680-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Stunt Double has a power of at least 2.
3680-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Stunt Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Stunt Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Stunt Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Stunt Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Stunt Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

953-5850.notablePrerequisites:
Twenty-Toed Toad does not have summoning sickness.
Your deck size is at least 21, minus 1 for each card in your hand.
953-5850.description:
Cast Enter the Infinite by paying {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}, causing you to draw your entire library and then put a card from your hand on top of your library.
Declare Twenty-Toed Toad as an attacker.
Twenty-Toed Toad's second ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

1912-4131-4694.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
1912-4131-4694.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2374-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2043-4636-5159.description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra triggers, creating a 4/4 artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart named Mishra's Warform.
Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Gonti's Aether Heart, causing you to get four energy counters.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a 3/3 Soldier artifact creature token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put the token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Gonti's Aether Heart token entering the battlefield triggers Mishra's Warform and Gonti's Aether Heart and itself, causing you to get six energy counters.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying eight energy counters and exiling it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2876-3757-4050.manaNeeded: {2}{W/B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2876-3757-4050.notablePrerequisites: Elenda has at least three +1/+1 counters on it, plus an additional +1/+1 counter for each time you've cast Elenda from the command zone this game.
2876-3757-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
Choose to return Elenda to the command zone from your graveyard.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and Felisa.
Resolve the Elenda trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Resolve the Felisa trigger, creating a number of 2/1 Inkling creature tokens equal to the number of counters on Elenda.
Cast Elenda from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Vampire or an Inkling, adding {W/B}.
The Vampire or Inkling dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining Vampire or Inkling.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-3529-4231-4772.notablePrerequisites: Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4772.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating two Treasure tokens, two Food tokens, and two Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

1027-2808.description:
Cast Wildwood Scourge by paying {1}{G}, causing it to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Wildwood Scourge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2018-3826-5256.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
2018-3826-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

364-813-1987-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
364-813-1987-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
